title: Tool library dialog: U3 large drawing of the tool to scale

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Goal: The tool library window draws the tool, its holder and their key dimensions to scale.

Parent: #3663. Plan: the implementation plan in the #3663 comment. This is PR U3 of 11. Refs #93: it fixes the preview leftovers.

Files:
- Add `tool_library_dialog/drawing.rs`. Draw the cutter, shank and holder body. Draw the dimension lines: diameter, flute length, shank, stick-out, gauge, holder diameter and length. Draw flute helix lines from `flutes` and `catalog.helix_deg` (decoration only). Add toggles.
- Change `tool_profile_page.rs` `preview_inputs` to return the landed `ToolCutter` outside "Draw cutter". This also fixes the Properties preview (#93 leftover).
- The holder outline comes from `HolderRef::points` or `tool_body_page::envelope`.
- Frame cost (`crates/ui/AGENTS.md`): cache the outlines. Key them on their input (the tool value, the `HolderRef`, the cutter revision), not on `doc_version`. Name the piece with `frame_cost::span`.

Tests (new): `tool_library_drawing::a_landed_drawn_cutter_shows_in_the_drawing`, `the_dimension_labels_are_painted`, `a_still_frame_computes_no_outline`, `a_changed_tool_redraws`. Update assertions only in `tool_preview.rs` and `tool_one_preview.rs` if needed. No test is removed.

Depends on: U2 (#3893).

Commands: none. Display only.

Expected quick gate: 10 steps.

Done means: the window shows a to-scale drawing with dimension labels. A landed drawn cutter shows in the drawing and in the Properties preview. A still frame computes no outline.

Changelog row: The tool library window draws the tool, its holder and their key dimensions to scale. The tool preview shows a drawn cutter.
